name: Devilish Business
source:
In Devilish Business you play as a recent high-school graduate with big plans for the summer, but a chance encounter with a mysterious stranger will change your life forever.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/BawdyBaron]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《Devilish Business》中，你将扮演一名刚刚高中毕业的年轻人，对暑假有着宏大的计划。然而，与一位神秘陌生人的偶遇，将永远改变你的人生。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/BawdyBaron]Patreon[/url]]
